54513.commentary: (VIN 2.5.9.4) ratanaṃ nāma muttā maṇi veḷuriyo saṅkho silā pavālaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ lohit'aṅko masāragallaṃ.

examples.text: yattakaṃ tulitā esā, tuyhaṃ dhītā anopamā, tato aṭṭhaguṇaṃ dassaṃ, hiraññaṃ ratanāni ca.
yaṃ kiñci vittaṃ idha vā huraṃ vā, saggesu vā yaṃ ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, na no samaṃ atthi tathāgatena, idam'pi buddhe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
tass'imāni satta ratanāni bhavanti, seyyath'idaṃ, cakkaratanaṃ, hatthiratanaṃ, assaratanaṃ, maṇiratanaṃ, itthiratanaṃ, gahapatiratanaṃ, pariṇāyakaratanam'eva sattamaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu rañño khattiyassa muddh'ābhisittassa anikkhantarājake aniggataratanake pubbe appaṭisaṃvidito indakhīlaṃ atikkāmeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

sattaratanaṃ vā, āvuso, nāgaṃ aḍḍh'aṭṭhamaratanaṃ vā tālapattikāya chādetabbaṃ maññeyya, yo me cha abhiññā chādetabbaṃ maññeyyā'ti.

54547.commentary: (MNa) rattaññutaṃ patto'ti ettha rattiyo jānantī'ti rattaññū. attano pabbajitadivasato paṭṭhāya bahū rattiyo jānanti, cirapabbajitā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. rattaññūnaṃ bhāvaṃ rattaññutaṃ. tatra rattaññutaṃ patte saṅghe upasenaṃ vaṅgantaputtaṃ ārabbha sikkhāpadaṃ paññattan'ti veditabbaṃ. so hāyasmā ūnadasavasse bhikkhū upasampādente disvā ekavasso saddhivihārikaṃ upasampādesi. atha bhagavā sikkhāpadaṃ paññapesi, na, bhikkhave, ūnadasavassena upasampādetabbo, yo upasampādeyya āpatti dukkaṭassā'ti (mahāva. 75). evaṃ paññatte sikkhāpade puna bhikkhū dasavassamhā dasavassamhā'ti bālā abyattā upasampādenti. atha bhagavā aparam'pi sikkhāpadaṃ paññapesi, na, bhikkhave, bālena abyattena upasampādetabbo, yo upasampādeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassa. anujānāmi, bhikkhave, byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena dasavassena vā atirekadasavassena vā upasampādetun'ti. iti rattaññutaṃ pattakāle dve sikkhāpadāni paññattāni.

examples.text: na tāva, bhaddāli, idh'ekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti yāva na saṅgho lābh'aggaṃ patto hoti, yas'aggaṃ patto hoti, bāhusaccaṃ patto hoti, rattaññutaṃ patto hoti.

evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kāsīsu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ. tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, ahaṃ kho, bhikkhave, aññatr'eva rattibhojanā bhuñjāmi.

54586.meaning1: shines at night; glows in the evening

examples.text: cattāro loke pajjotā, pañcam'ettha na vijjati, divā tapati ādicco, rattim'ābhāti candimā.

54587.grammar: idiom, fem + ind + nt + ind, gen abs

examples.text: yañ'ca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vuccati cittaṃ iti'pi mano iti'pi viññāṇaṃ iti'pi taṃ rattiyā ca divasassa ca añña'd'eva uppajjati aññaṃ nirujjhati

54588.grammar: idiom, fem + adj + masc, loc abs
54588.meaning1: in the last watch of the night

examples.text: ajja kho, pan'ānanda, rattiyā pacchime yāme kusinārāyaṃ upavattane mallānaṃ sālavane antarena yamakasālānaṃ tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati

54590.meaning1: (of a robe) lived apart from for one night

examples.text: idaṃ me, bhante, cīvaraṃ rattivippavutthaṃ aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā nissaggiyaṃ, im'āhaṃ saṅghassa nissajjāmī'ti

54591.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of ratti
54591.meaning1: at night; by night; on the night; for a night

examples.text: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā, abhibhuyya disā sabbā, appamāṇasamādhinā.
pāṇaṃ na haññe na c'adinnam'ādiye, musā na bhāse na ca majjapo siyā, abrahmacariyā virameyya methunā, rattiṃ na bhuñjeyya vikālabhojanaṃ.

54592.meaning1: eating food at the wrong time during the night; eating after sunset

examples.text: te mayaṃ, bhante, bhagavati pemañ'ca gāravañca hiriñ'ca ottappañ'ca sampassamānā evaṃ taṃ rattiṃvikālabhojanaṃ pajahimhā.

54594.meaning2: like the tips of red lotuses

54595.meaning1: abstaining from eating at night; stopped the evening meal

examples.text: ekabhattiko hoti ratt'ūparato virato vikālabhojanā

54596.grammar: ind, adv, sk loc sg of ratti

examples.text: kesaṃ divā ca ratto ca, sadā puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati, dhammaṭṭhā sīlasampannā, ke janā saggagāmino'ti.
tasmā hi bhūtā nisāmetha sabbe, mettaṃ karotha mānusiyā pajāya, divā ca ratto ca haranti ye baliṃ, tasmā hi ne rakkhatha appamattā.
mah'odadhiṃ aparimitaṃ mahāsaraṃ, bahubheravaṃ ratnagaṇānam'ālayaṃ, najjo yathā naragaṇasaṅghasevitā, puthū savantī upayanti sāgaraṃ.

54599.grammar: fem, gen sg of ratti, irreg form of rattiyā
54599.commentary: (JAa) ratyā vivasāne'ti rattīnaṃ accayena, cirakāl'ātikkamenā'ti attho. (JAa) tato ratyā vivasāne'ti bhikkhave, tato tassā rattiyā accayena sūriye uggate dānaveyyāvatikā dānaṃ paṭiyāditan'ti rañño ārocayiṃsu.

examples.text: tato ratyā vivasāne, sūriyass'uggamanaṃ pati, sabbaṃ taṇhaṃ visosetvā, pallaṅkena upāvisin'ti.
tato ratyā vivasāne, gām'antam'abhihāraye, avhānaṃ n'ābhinandeyya, abhihārañ'ca gāmato.
